title: Weather Beats Generic Telemetry Data Point
description: Standalone lightweight ingestion envelope for generic telemetry data points mapping to the 24-domain canonical telemetry registry.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 date-time string indicating when the telemetry data point was recorded (e.g., 2026-11-12T21:47:46Z or 2026-11-12T21:47:46-08:00).

source_id.description: Unique non-empty identifier for the originating data source, sensor node, or external connector.

domain.description: Canonical intelligence domain identifier (e.g., 'weather', 'financial') matching the 24-domain Universal Intelligence registry.

payload.description: Domain-specific telemetry data object holding measurements, metrics, and contextual attributes.
